title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-04-06
content:
Daily scratchpad - 2026-04-06
Owner: Jordan Lee (PM) - product-hosted-api

High-level goal for week: finalize PRD and launch checklist for Hosted API streaming + function-calling beta for customers (tier: self-serve + early enterprise beta).

Top priorities
- PRD: incorporate SRE feedback on throttling/fallback behavior (priority: high)
- Launch checklist: finalize runbook, monitoring dashboards, rollback criteria, and customer comms
- Stakeholder syncs: Eng, SRE, DevEx, Legal (data residency), Sales AE (beta invites)

09:00 - Eng sync (Marco + Samir)
- Marco: kernels/throughput are stable on 80% load; we still see 10-15% variance w/ long-contexts
- Samir: streaming infra needs a short-term mitigation for partial-response retries (INF-4032)
- Decision: add a lightweight client-side dedupe + server-idempotency token to reduce duplicate function calls on retry
Action: Marco to scope changes and time estimate by EOD (JIRA-INF-4032)

10:30 - SRE quick check (Aisha)
- Aisha requested: clear latency SLOs for streaming endpoints and documented fallback policy to non-streaming model variant
- TODO: add SLO table to PRD and explicit fallback TTL + circuit-breaker thresholds
Action: Jordan to add SLO table to PRD (section: "Reliability & Fallbacks") and share with SRE by 2026-04-07

Notes on PRD edits (what to add/resolve)
- Add matrix for client SDK behaviors: streaming vs non-streaming, function-calling idempotency, retry semantics
- Define telemetry events we need for quality/regressions: token-latency, truncated-response-rate, function-call-duplicates
- Security: confirm KMS usage for any function payloads - Legal to confirm data retention limits for beta customers (ask Legal: Priya)
- UX: DevEx requested example call patterns + quickstart snippet for JS/Python + cURL

Open questions / blockers
- Legal has a few data-residency asks for EU beta customers; until addressed, limit EU beta to enterprise customers only
- Billing: need a chapter in PRD for per-token vs streaming-minute billing model - Finance to propose pricing by 04/09

Launch checklist (rough)
- [ ] PRD final + sign-off (PM, Eng lead, SRE, DevEx, Legal)
- [ ] Runbook: start/stop, failover steps, rollback playbook
- [ ] Monitoring dashboards: latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), partial-response-rate, error-rate, function-duplicate-rate
- [ ] Alerting: on-call runbook + escalation path
- [ ] SDK quickstarts + sample app (GH PR 872) - DevEx owner: Samir
- [ ] Beta invite list + comms template (Sales + CS) - owner: Maya in GTM (I'll coordinate)
- [ ] Compliance check for EU / data residency - Legal: Priya
- [ ] Billing model decision and metrics for cost tracking - Finance
- [ ] Post-launch QA checklist and scheduled 1-week retrospective

Owner assignments (current)
- PRD edits: Jordan (assignee) + review: Marco, Aisha, Samir, Priya
- SDK snippets + sample app: Samir (DevEx) - GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-api/pull/872
- Runbook + monitoring: Aisha (SRE) + Marco (eng infra)
- Beta comms: Maya (GTM) + Jordan (PM)

Quick follow-ups to send today
- Email Legal (Priya): confirm EU data-retention limits + KMS requirements - tag: JIRA-INF-4081
- Ping Finance: request pricing model options for streaming (per-token vs per-minute)
- Ask DevEx (Samir): finish SDK snippet + merge GH PR 872 by EOD Thu

Meeting notes (short)
- Product-Eng rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 72 hours with automatic rollback on p99 latency > x ms or function-duplicate-rate > 0.5%
- Fallback policy: if streaming infra degrades, route to non-streaming variant with sticky session TTL 30s and log truncation events

Misc scratch ideas
- Consider offering "streaming preview" toggle in Console so AEs can enable for specific customers (makes beta invites easier)
- Add an internal flag in request metadata to enable verbose telemetry for early testers

End-of-day checklist
- [ ] Update PRD with SLO table + SDK matrix
- [ ] Create PR with SDK snippets (Samir) & link to PRD
- [ ] Update JIRA-INF-4032 with mitigation plan from Marco

Random notes to self
- Keep PRD short - move deep-dive technical design to eng ADR linked in PRD
- Remember to copy CS on beta comms template so they can prepare onboarding docs

References / links
- PRD draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/PROD-STREAM-12345
- Ticket: JIRA-INF-4032
- SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-api/pull/872
summary: Daily PM scratchpad capturing PRD edits, launch checklist, stakeholder actions for Hosted API streaming + function-calling beta. Owners assigned and follow-ups noted.
